notes: VS-25 extends the existing provider-neutral public discovery boundary; it does not add private provider connectors.
Third-party public image binaries are never copied or rehosted; only bounded remote references and provenance are retained.
Structured menu facts use the generic Business Offering model with menu-item as the initial kind so Atlas Core remains industry-agnostic.
Public media/menu observations remain unconfirmed unless explicitly confirmed by the owner in a future UI.
No production deployment or production enablement is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner explicitly approved the sequence: fix readiness CTA, add restaurant/business media capture, then add structured menu/menu-price ingestion.
Approved retention is bounded to public remote media references and factual offering metadata with provenance. Third-party binaries, private APIs, OCR and owner-upload storage remain out of scope.
Product Owner instructed implementation to proceed with 'Go' on the explicitly highlighted media/menu sequence.
Certification requires deterministic extraction, PostgreSQL persistence/migration, isolation and regression gates at the exact implementation SHA.
